summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for LifeChart — a patient-friendly lifelong health timeline for India built on ABDM/ABHA. Covers 85 files across 18 build steps: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4 frontend, Supabase PostgreSQL backend with 10 RLS-secured tables, Tesseract.js Hindi+English OCR, consent-based doctor access, family management, emergency cards, vaccination tracking, and medicine reminders. Includes realistic mock data for an Indian patient (Rajesh Kumar Sharma) with 25+ health records spanning 2009-2024.
